How many golf courses are on Koh Samui? | Two: Santiburi Samui Country Club, an 18-hole, par-72 course in the hills above Mae Nam, and the 9-hole Royal Samui Golf & Country Club in the hills between Bophut, Chaweng and Lamai.
How much is a round of golf at Santiburi on Koh Samui? | About 5,600 THB for 18 holes and 2,825 THB for 9 holes in 2026, with caddie and cart included. Some listings quote lower early or late rates, so ask when you book.
Is a caddie compulsory at Samui's golf courses? | At Santiburi, yes: a caddie and a cart are compulsory and both are included in the green fee. Royal Samui has no caddies; you drive your own cart.
Can I rent golf clubs on Koh Samui? | Yes. Santiburi's pro shop has rental clubs, and Royal Samui lends clubs. Reserve them with your tee time in high season.
What is the dress code for golf on Koh Samui? | A collared shirt and tailored shorts or trousers, with soft spikes at Santiburi. No swimwear, vests or denim on the course.
What is the best time of day to play golf on Koh Samui? | The first tee times around 07:00, or late afternoon. Midday reaches 32–33 °C from May to September, and an 18-hole round in the hills takes about 4–4.5 hours.
Do I need to book a tee time on Koh Samui? | It is wise to book a few days ahead from December to April, the busiest season, and at least a day ahead the rest of the year. Santiburi is open to non-members every day.
Can you book a tee time for us? | Tee times are booked directly with the club, so there's no mark-up. We can help plan the day and arrange a private van that waits at the course, from 2,500 THB for 4 hours for up to 10 people.
Where can I play tennis on Koh Samui? | Mostly at resorts and private villas with their own courts; public pay-by-the-hour courts are rare. Choose accommodation with a court, or ask other resorts whether non-guests can book.
Is there padel on Koh Samui? | Yes, at least four clubs: in Bophut near Fisherman's Village, Choeng Mon and Plai Laem, Lamai and Ban Tai in Mae Nam. Courts cost about 600–1,200 THB per hour, with covered courts for rainy days.
